notes: Tuition: The DAAD page says 'Tuition fees per semester None' but also states a semester contribution. This is a general statement for the university and it is unclear whether it applies to non-EU students; no non-EU tuition fee is stated for this programme, so no tuition fact is included. Intakes: The DAAD page names 'Beginning Winter semester' but no dates, so only the startDate is null and no year can be inferred. ApplicationChannel: The university page requires a VPD from uni-assist for foreign educational certificates; this is a de-uni-assist-vpd route.

note.fr: Vérifiez les dates limites de candidature auprès de l'université : la page DAAD indique seulement « Winter semester » et renvoie au site web de l'université. Une pré-vérification des documents (VPD) par uni-assist et des frais de candidature de 80 EUR pour les non-EU sont exigés.
note.en: Check the application deadlines with the university: the DAAD page only says 'Winter semester' and links to the university website. A preliminary review of documents (VPD) by uni-assist and an application fee of 80 EUR for non-EU applicants are required.
